status: audited; six unique historical FlyWire intermediate contents unresolved, latest versions preserved
scope: Per-file source identity audit of four representative retained manifests. Does not claim every historical campaign has an identical provenance schema.

historical_blob_search.scope: Reachable original Git history restricted to the unresolved source paths; matched by content SHA-256, not by assuming another commit is the experiment version.

all_object_search.scope: All currently present Git blobs up to 500000 bytes, including objects unreachable from refs. Exact matches additionally preserved as standalone content on T7.

preservation.maintenance_policy: Maintain latest implementations; retain historical result records and actual source identities. Missing intermediate bytes are an explicit historical reproduction limitation, not a product migration blocker.
